step.label: flat-app-rotation-skydomes
step.title: Flat local Sun skydome diagnostics by rotation from San Jose closest approach

sourceBoundary.appConfigurationUsed: DEFAULT_FLAT_SIMULATION_CONFIG, DEFAULT_FLAT_SIMULATION_SUN, DEFAULT_ATMOSPHERE.rendering.falseSunRadiance, and MEAN_EARTH_RADIUS_KM from flat app consts
sourceBoundary.localProjectSourcesUsed: app configuration constants only; projection, closest approach, rotation offsets, direction, configured source distance, source incident scale, and apparent size are computed in atmosflat32
sourceBoundary.note: These skydomes visualize source placement only; they are not local Algorithm32 scattering validation.

skyViewRayLengthLimit.scope: observer angular sky renderer only; not a flat atmosphere or scene-renderer distance limit

geometry.viewDistancePolicy: same fisheye skydome loop as round Algorithm32; only the observer sky renderer terminates flat view rays at a round-equivalent artificial cap while atmosphere density and source paths use flat z-up geometry

brightnessCalibration.targetIncidentScaleUnits: multiple of Algorithm32 distant-directional-sun top-of-atmosphere solar irradiance
